ownerStrategyLab.description: Build 36 owner strategy lab. Uses the live ranking, the app review statuses and the app sizing rules. Idle cash earns SPY. Analyst estimates are unavailable historically, so the analyst-based parts of the live model are NOT tested here. Development = before 2022, validation = 2022 onward. Read once; do not tune to it.

passFail.question1: Do live ranks 1-20 beat ranks 251+ on 1Y and 3Y excess return? (rankBuckets)
passFail.question2: Does arm C beat both SPY and the equal-weight universe, in development AND validation?
passFail.question3: Does conviction sizing (C) beat equal weight (B)? Does concentration (E vs C vs F) help or just add volatility?
passFail.question4: Build 62b: does the experimental thesis-broken auto-sell (C+) beat the default review-only rules (C)? See thesisBreakSells.
passFail.question5: Build 65: do growth ranks 1-10 beat 31+ and non-growth stocks (growthBuckets)? Does G beat SPY in development AND validation, and does H beat C?
